content.text:
I removed the four CSS rules that coloured each item's left border by priority. The overdue highlight is now the only colour on the list, and the checks pass.
Priorities still work: you can still set one when adding a todo, it is saved, and the list is still sorted by it. Items still carry `data-priority`.
I didn't add a text label in place of the colour. That means you can't see a single todo's priority anymore, only the sort order.
